title: Mandatory Electronic Runner Tracking
claims: All runners must carry a Hardrock-issued GPS transmitter for the full duration of the run, and a pacer cannot carry it for the runner.
The transmitter is issued on Wednesday or Thursday at runner check-in and is returned after the runner finishes or withdraws.
Hardrock uses the Spot Gen3 tracker and the MAProgress tracking system.
A runner is not disqualified if the transmitter is lost, broken or accidentally left with crew.
Instructions for initiating a rescue are provided with the device, and initiating a rescue means the runner has dropped and cannot re-enter the run.
